name: Pushpit Virmani
title: Senior Product Manager
summary: Result-driven Senior Product Manager with 5+ years of experience in the Tech and AI industry. Holds a Master's degree from ESCP Business School combining business acumen with deep technical understanding of AI/ML, conversational agents, and checkout payment platforms. Demonstrated track record in driving 0→1 product launches ($250k ARR in 10 days), scaling merchant GMV (50+ Cr GMV increase at Paytm), building Voice/Chatbot AI agents, and implementing data-driven product strategies with cross-functional engineering and GTM teams.
